My dear [Miss Butler](../persons.html#237)
I enclose with the [Packet](../others.html#52)’s warm thanks the pay for [Likes & Dislikes](../others.html#248). I am so glad to think of the continuation for I think the notion of setting Emily to tame young ladies running to seed an excellent one.
[Miss Sturges Bourne](../persons.html#1379) has just been conducting a sick cousin to Wiesbaden, and thinking with much diversion of Helen.

She was near going to Marienbad itself which would have been amusing. I hope [Lizzie Barnett](../persons.html#113) has been gaining all sorts of strength at St Leonards.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
